h1: Victoria + Albert bathroom installation in Gerrards Cross

hero.intro: We install luxury, fit-only bathrooms for homeowners across Gerrards Cross, the affluent Buckinghamshire commuter village close to Beaconsfield and Chalfont St Peter, around 25 to 30 minutes by road from our Bracknell base. A Victoria + Albert freestanding bath is a common request on these jobs, and it comes with its own planning requirements: the baths are cast from a volcanic limestone and resin composite rather than acrylic or steel, giving them genuine weight, so floor loading, access route and waste position are all worked out before the bath leaves the showroom. You source the sanitaryware, brassware, tiles and furniture; we strip out, first-fix, tile, plumb and snag, from £3,500.

sections.heading: Fit-only Victoria + Albert installation for Gerrards Cross homes
sections.body: Our model is straightforward: you buy the Victoria + Albert bath, basin, brassware, tiles and furniture from your chosen suppliers, and we carry out the installation. For a village like Gerrards Cross, within easy reach of our Bracknell base, that typically means a site visit to survey the room, a stripped-out and re-plumbed bathroom, full tiling, and a snagged, finished installation at the end. The brand's freestanding baths tend to be the centrepiece of the room, so we plan the rest of the layout — flooring, tiling, lighting positions — around where that bath will sit.

sections.heading: Why Victoria + Albert's construction changes the installation plan
sections.body: Victoria + Albert's freestanding baths are cast from a volcanic limestone and resin composite, not acrylic or steel, which gives them a solid, cool-to-the-touch surface and genuine weight. That's a point that matters as much to how we get the bath into the room as it does to how it sits once installed. We plan the floor loading, the access route through the house, and the waste position before the bath ever leaves the showroom, so there are no surprises on delivery day — particularly important in a property where the bathroom might be on an upper floor.

sections.heading: The survey and installation process
sections.body: We start with a paid survey, £125, where we look at the room, the access route from the front door through to the bathroom, and the floor structure where the bath will sit. From there we confirm the waste position and plan first-fix plumbing accordingly. Installation covers strip-out of the existing bathroom, first-fix, tiling, final plumbing connections and snagging once everything is finished. Projects start from £3,500 depending on scope, and because we're fit-only, you keep full control over which Victoria + Albert products you buy and where from.

sections.heading: What's included, and what isn't
sections.body: We handle everything on the trade side of the job: removing the old bathroom, adjusting plumbing and waste runs to suit the new Victoria + Albert bath, tiling the room, connecting and testing all plumbing, and snagging the finished installation. What we don't do is sell or supply the bath, basin, brassware, tiles or furniture — that stays with you, which gives you full choice over the Victoria + Albert range and your preferred supplier, with us focused purely on getting it installed properly.

sections.heading: Booking an installation in Gerrards Cross
sections.body: If you're planning a Victoria + Albert bathroom in Gerrards Cross, the first step is the £125 survey, which lets us assess the room properly before quoting the installation. Call or WhatsApp 07399 651836 to arrange a visit.
